reuse.why: Uses the schedule's own occurrences iterator and d.isWeekend, but adds the daily rule inline in getNextDate instead of in a shared weekend-adjustment helper the other paths could use.

duplication.why: The diff itself duplicates little; the inline loop re-queries occurrences one at a time rather than sharing a skip helper.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but only inside getNextDate, while getUpcomingDates (schedules/app.ts) and schedule-template.ts apply the weekend rule through getDateWithSkippedWeekend and still move daily occurrences.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: The weekend rule now has two definitions (daily in getNextDate, move-only in getDateWithSkippedWeekend), and the daily check reads the raw dateCond.value.frequency instead of the parsed schedule data used next to it.

one_place.where: Daily skip is added only in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts); getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend directly and move weekend occurrences of daily schedules.
